name: facet-filter
title: Facet filter
description: A filter button that opens a searchable checklist with row counts; picks show on the button as chips or a count, with Clear filter at the foot.
docs: Counts are yours to compute: pass how many rows each option would leave given the other filters. Options at zero stay in place, dimmed, so the list never reshuffles while people click. The button's accessible name lists the picks, and on a narrow screen long names in the chips give way with an ellipsis. The list is a multi-select checklist named after the filter, and each option says whether it is checked. Controlled with `value` and `onValueChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`.
